Conversation, family & daily routines

lean on verb

also push with the feet, support oneself, push upward, push

classical

nītor, nītī, nīsus sum / nīxus sum

verb, third conjugation, deponent

lean or bear upon, support oneself, push upward

Deponent. The supporting limb or object may be in the ablative.

Examples

  • Pedibus nītere.

    Push with your feet / support yourself on your feet.composed

See also pull, lift.

SourcesLewis & Short: nitor

The reflexive and limb-based prompts are composed. In particular, nītere is the singular imperative of deponent nītor. Examples are composed for conversation with Theo; dictionary links document the component words, not these exact sentences or standardized modern climbing terminology.

The example sentences marked “composed” are ours.
